title: ArchiMate
summary: ArchiMate — an Open Group modeling language for enterprise architecture covering business, application and technology layers and their relationships.
body_markdown:
# ArchiMate

## Scope

Enterprise architecture modeling notation with layers (business, application, technology), aspects and relationship types.

## Requirements

Notation specification; not a data modeling language.

## Applicability

Representing data architecture in enterprise context (data objects, application components, flows). ArchiMate's layers are not the same as this knowledge base's [[Architecture Layer|data architecture layers]]; a mapping is an open task.

## Related Architecture Concepts

[[Architecture Layer]], [[Data Architecture]].

## Related Controls

None.
